name: DEAD CHANNEL 13 Original Anime Soundtrack Pack
description: 6 tracks (OP, ED, 32s shots.json combat cue, and 3 character themes) tailored for Google Flow- Movies.

tracks.title: STATIC RESONANCE (13 Seconds to Midnight)
tracks.cueNotes: Main opening theme; export all 4 stems so dialogue trailers can mute lead vocals.
tracks.prompt: 1999 Japanese anime opening theme fusing urgent Cowboy Bebop brass stabs, Yu Yu Hakusho slap-bass rock funk, tight breakbeat acoustic drums, gritty overdrive guitar riffs, and charismatic male rock/soul vocals. Warm analog tape saturation, explosive horn fills, 148 BPM in F# minor.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Analog tape hiss, CRT degauss hum, dry slap-bass pickup into horn hit)

[Verse 1]
Rain hits the glass at two-thirteen
Copper wires humming on a dead CRT
Thirteen seconds on the Nixie dial
Rewrite the static with a crooked smile

[Pre-Chorus]
Lock the toggle down, hear the vacuum glow
Every erased shadow wants another go!

[Chorus]
Break through the static - Channel Thirteen!
Punching out the ghost in the phosphor screen!
Thirteen seconds burning red and blue
Spin the phase-tape back till we pull you through!

[Bridge]
(Half-time Rhodes + clockwork rimshot ticks)
Freeze the raindrops in midair -
One snap, and nobody's there...

[Final Chorus]
Break through the static - Channel Thirteen!
Shatter all the glass in the rain-soaked dream!
Hold the frequency, never fade to gray
We rewrite midnight till the break of day!

tracks.title: RAIN ON THE GLASS (02:13 AM)
tracks.cueNotes: Closing credits theme for Dead Channel 13 episodes.
tracks.prompt: Late-night 1990s anime noir ending ballad at 78 BPM in D minor. Smoky tenor saxophone solo, warm trembling Fender Rhodes chords, brushed snare drums, deep upright walking bass, subtle vinyl crackle and distant rain atmosphere, intimate alto vocal with midnight Tokyo restraint.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Brushed snare, muted sax swell, warm Rhodes seventh chords)

[Verse 1]
Neon puddles on the catwalk steel
Counting every second that we couldn't steal
Cigarette embers in a Shibuya breeze
Voices lingering on dead frequencies

[Chorus]
Rain on the glass, two-thirteen AM
Playing back the tape just to hear you again
If the ink washes out before the morning light
Leave the porch lamp burning on the static tonight

[Outro]
(Solo Rhodes + soft rain tail)

tracks.title: ZERO BEAT PROTOCOL (Rain on the Glass Combat Cue)
tracks.cueNotes: Timed directly to shots.json Cuts 01-05 (0-6s boxing groove, 6-12s Zero Beat vacuum drop, 12-18s rewind tension, 18-26s sakuga brass climax, 26-32s noir cooldown). Use cues.json with Invoke-DeadChannelScoreMix.ps1.
tracks.prompt: Instrumental 1990s anime martial-arts showdown score at 132 BPM in C minor. Begins with tight loose-swing boxing percussion and acid-jazz slap bass, drops abruptly into eerie sub-bass vacuum silence with a ticking rimshot, accelerates with analog modular arpeggios and snare rolls, explodes into furious horn section + rock guitar + breakbeat sakuga climax, then resolves into lone noir muted trumpet and rain-soaked Rhodes cooldown. Instrumental only.
tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
Timed cue for Dead Channel 13 Showcase Scene (Cuts 01-05, 32s).

tracks.title: Taped Knuckles & Static Pulse
tracks.cueNotes: Renji Takanashi character leitmotif; seamless loopable bars.
tracks.prompt: Confident 90s street-brawler funk breakbeat at 116 BPM in E minor. Crisp acoustic drum break, gritty electric clavinet, agile slap bass, dusty brass punches, and loose Jeet Kune Do rhythm swagger. Instrumental only, seamless loop.

tracks.title: Amber Nixie / Cold Scanline
tracks.cueNotes: Toma Kurose & Sora Hayakawa control-booth tension bed.
tracks.prompt: Tense 1999 analog electronics laboratory theme at 94 BPM in A minor. Warm Juno-60 synth arpeggios, Fender Rhodes chords, subtle magnetic tape flutter, muted rimshot pulse, and soft acoustic bass evoking vacuum tubes and CRT oscilloscopes at midnight. Instrumental, seamless loop.

tracks.title: Zero Beat / Obsidian Metronome
tracks.prompt: Predatory dark anime antagonist theme at 128 BPM in G minor. Razor-sharp koto/harpsichord plucks, heavy distorted bass ostinato, crisp metronomic woodblock clicks, brooding baritone sax, and ominous brass swells evoking time-stopping precision and dark fire. Instrumental, clean 4-stem separation.
